en: I'd rather you came to the lake than here.
If you brought me even one little souvenir,
my attitude would be different, you know.
Just kidding.
Did you come to see me?
Just kidding. Is there something you need?
I was just about to make candles...
Oh, might you actually help me?
Oh, never mind. I wouldn't have minded...
Well then, hold this for a moment.
If you really have business with me,
you're welcome anytime.
What are you doing here?
I'm cutting reeds.
I cut the reeds around here,
and use them for things like thatching roofs.
Oh, you're still here.
Have you got nothing to do?
Do you have some business around here?
It's such a remote spot, after all,
there's usually nobody else around.

note: ',' after the name, honorific dropped (#143 = '.'); next row continues the sentence in lower case

en: are you actually doing your work?
You're always out here.
Oh, or are you maybe coming to see me?
Of course not, right?
I also make candles out of these reeds.
That's important work at home, too.
Oh, I know,
note: 'Oh, I know, ' + name + ',' (#2269 / #2308); both 107728 and 108446 read as 'Oh, I know, NAME, ...'

en: why don't you make some with me too?
Come to my house if you feel like it.
Carrying the cut reeds is hard work, too.
I'm such a delicate girl. Oh dear,
I wish some nice gentleman would help me.
...Oh well, it's my job, after all.
Johanna, is it?
In a case like this, telling me your name too is
just good manners, you know.
Ah, sorry. I'm
O-oh,
note: Flustered repeat of the name: 'O-oh, ' + name + '.' (#13 = '.')

en: Nice to meet you.
I'm just on my way to the lake to cut grass.
Good morning,
note: Name goes on the next line; shared with Emmy (msgs 115404, 115947)

en: But as for anything nicer than getting to see you,
I wonder if there is any.
Sure enough, we met. Somehow, today,
note: Joins 'Good evening, NAME.' with #2230 (I had a feeling I'd see you)

en: wouldn't do you any harm, you know,
note: Needs #2234 (slice 027) to end in a quote, e.g. Saying "Pleased to meet you,"; then NAME + '.'

en: Ah... nice to meet you.
Very good.
Do you need something from me?
If you need me for something, rather than here,
I'd be happier if you came to the lake.
you came to see me, didn't you.
note: After NAME + ',' (#21); 'you came to see me, didn't you.'

en: Just kidding. What do you want?
I was just about to make candles, you see...
That's enough, thank you. Bye now.
What are you doing here?
Oh, you're still here. Nothing to do?
there's usually nobody around.
Oh, honestly, how silly of me.
Do you mind that I come to see you?
Huh? Wh-what? That's not what I meant!
I'm happy when you come to see me,
I mean, I look forward to it, or something.
Um, well,
that's not what I mean...
I'm sorry, I got all flustered.
let's make some together sometime.
Hey, wait, don't run away,
Johanna, I never get bored with you.
So be with me at night, too.
I'm sorry.
It's only for a little while.
I want to be with you always, but...
I belong to you.
Somehow, I feel as if I'm no longer my own...
Good day. Daedalus
is laid up with an illness right now.
